data.description:
Our Retractable Leash is designed with an ergonomic handle and anti-slip locking button, so you can walk your pup confidently and safely.
Created for pet parents who want to give their furry friend more freedom while maintaining safety and control at all times, from roaming to every outing like a walk in the park.
Equipped with anti-fray and anti-tangle nylon ribbon, automatically adjusts with your dog's movements.
The inner spring mechanism keeps the lead under slight tension for total control.
Precautions: Keep out of reach of small children. Never let anyone play with this leash. Avoid contact with the cord/tape/belt and never let it wrap around any part of your body. To safely operate, you must be able to maintain control of your dog at all times in order to prevent your dog from bolting off or entangling a bystander in the leash tape.

Specification:

The retractable dog leash can be extended up to 3-5 meters, giving your dog a perfect range and freedom of movement.

The handle part is made of environmentally friendly materials, which will not cause allergies to pets or human skin.

Retractable design, the belt can be automatically retracted.

It's great for walking and training and controls your pet with ease.

Made of high-quality materials, durable and safe.

Product name: retractable pet leash

Material: ABS, PC

Features: Pet Supplies, Durable, Automatic, Retractable, Leash
